request: Give agents an executable definition of done and leave a detailed plan an implementation-focused model can follow.
scope: Check planning handoffs before commit and exercise each requested behavior before push via the existing Git hooks.
setup: Run commands from the PARK repository root. Install Git and the project Python dependencies, then enable hooks with python3 tools/push_gate/gate.py install. Gate regression tests use temporary local repositories.
constraints: Read the exact staged or committed inputs. Preserve existing checks. Run named tests using fixed runner commands. Keep plan-only work deliverable before its implementation exists.

steps.action: Read the current hook configuration and add a fast index check that rejects incomplete handoffs and unmapped behavior changes. Make branch plans available to later commits.

verify.expected: Exit zero for this complete handoff.

steps.action: Extend the existing push gate to execute the exact named cases from the proposed commit and propagate any failures. Preserve the repository checks already attached to push.

verify.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_push_gate.py -k test_handoff_rejections
verify.expected: The test passes after observing each invalid push fail and the remote reference stay absent.

steps.action: Add real Git fixtures for planning, valid implementation and broken behavior. Document the commands and the handoff lifecycle for the next implementer.

verify.expected: All Git fixtures pass, including acceptance through staged commits and pushes to a bare remote.

steps.action: Refresh the required Semgrep pin, verify the three wheel digests against the official release and run the native control scan on macOS ARM64.

verify.expected: The real native scanner detects the fixtures across all eleven declared target extensions.

acceptance.entrypoint: git commit and git push to a local bare repository
acceptance.given: The staged plan names a count function and two future acceptance tests.
acceptance.when: Commit and push the plan, implement the function and tests, then commit and push the implementation.
acceptance.then: Both planned and implemented states reach the remote. Unmapped staged implementation is rejected before its commit.

acceptance.entrypoint: git push to a local bare repository
acceptance.given: The public count function must clamp a negative value; a positive result alone is insufficient.
acceptance.when: Push variants with a missing, skipped, empty or failing boundary, then remove the clamp with the original assertions in place.
acceptance.then: Each push exits unsuccessfully and leaves the target reference absent.

acceptance.entrypoint: Official wheel verification in the offline native installer
acceptance.given: The current release has one reviewed SHA256 digest for each of the three supported platforms.
acceptance.when: Read the installer version and artifact identities alongside the documented installation procedure.
acceptance.then: The installer and the guide agree with all three reviewed release digests.

acceptance.given: A supplied wheel differs from the expected SHA256 identity.
acceptance.when: Attempt to read the wheel with the reviewed digest.
acceptance.then: The installer rejects the payload before opening the ZIP archive.
